title: 2.4.12 Break When the Square Passes 50
description: Count up from 1 and break as soon as the square of the count exceeds 50. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Set up the counter
steps.instructions: Declare a variable called n and set it to 1.

steps.title: Loop until the square passes 50
steps.instructions: Write a while (true) loop. Inside, check whether n * n is greater than 50. If it is, log n and its square, then break. Otherwise add 1 to n and let the loop continue.

planChart.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A([Start]) --> B[set n to 1]
  B --> C{n times n is greater than 50}
  C -- no --> F[add 1 to n]
  F --> C
  C -- yes --> D[/log n and its square/]
  D --> E([End])
